measurement_basis.current_left_drawer: clamp(320px, 27vw, 360px); measured in 8B.1 evidence as 360px at 1440, 345.6px at 1280, 320px at 1024/768, and full viewport width at 390.
measurement_basis.method: Layout arithmetic uses actual CSS widths and 8B.1 measured drawer widths. Map usability judgments are qualitative and must be rechecked with live map/data after 8E.
measurement_basis.limitation: The available 8B.1 screenshots show the shell and drawer but do not include a paired right inspector. Captured base-map tiles were unavailable, so screenshots prove panel geometry/density, not live map usability.

B_rail_left_task_drawer_map.purpose: Current task configuration/action; drawer stays independent from inspected entity.

C_rail_map_right_inspector.purpose: Inspect spatial entity when no left task drawer is visible or at responsive replacement widths.

D_rail_left_task_map_right_inspector.purpose: Keep workflow and entity ownership distinct without making map interaction impractical.

width_budget.behavior: Push both panels. Map remains a broad working canvas with cell, building, and RF-layer interaction.
Push both; comfortable enough for regional/local map with the inspector kept compact. Validate with real tile/map and toolbar controls.
Right inspector overlays the map while left tool remains open; the unobstructed corridor is about 672px. The map remains navigable but this is the lower desktop dual-panel limit.
Do not keep both side panels. Inspector temporarily occupies the left tool-drawer slot with a Back-to-Propagation/owning-tool action; map has one panel footprint and task state is retained.
Single inspector panel replaces the left task drawer; map remains a 616px-wide workspace. Back restores tool; no dual panels.
One full-width bottom sheet at a time, max about 55vh; preserve a broad upper map area instead of a 360px side strip.
One sheet at a time. Keep entity title/close/back visible, scroll details inside the sheet, and leave a useful map strip. No three-column layout.

panel_policy.1920: Push; independent collapse/close for each panel.
panel_policy.1600: Push; 832px map region is the minimum width for dual desktop panes.
panel_policy.1440: Keep current left overlay behavior; right inspector overlays the map at the opposite edge. When map operations need more space, close either panel independently. Do not close task drawer on every inspect action.
panel_policy.1280: Inspector replaces/temporarily occupies task drawer host. Back restores exact prior tool and state; only one side panel visible.
panel_policy.1024: Same single-panel replacement; right edge anchoring is acceptable because the left drawer is hidden.
panel_policy.768: One bottom sheet at a time using current sheet language; no competing side overlays.
panel_policy.390: One bottom sheet at a time, with a compact/collapsed header and explicit Back/Close semantics.

keyboard_and_accessibility.landmark: Named complementary/region landmark, heading includes selected entity type and ID.
keyboard_and_accessibility.open_focus: Keyboard activation of Inspect moves focus to the inspector heading; pointer selection does not steal focus or announce every hover.
keyboard_and_accessibility.close_focus: Close returns focus to the initiating map feature/action when it still exists; otherwise to the map toolbar/owning tool.
keyboard_and_accessibility.escape: Escape closes transient submenus first, then inspector, then drawer according to existing chooser/map-tool priority.
keyboard_and_accessibility.status: Freshness and entity state use text plus icon/structure; color is supplementary.
keyboard_and_accessibility.touch: Keep close/back and primary context actions at accessible touch sizes; mobile details scroll within the sheet.
